social_circle.name: Kathy Cintron-Walsh

demographics.occupation: retired elementary school teacher (taught ~35 years in Ann Arbor Public Schools)
demographics.education: B.A. in Elementary Education, Eastern Michigan University; M.Ed. in Reading Instruction

background.how_they_met: Deeva's first child, born 1962 in Saline; grew up in the family home on Michigan Avenue
background.why_close: Kathy lives closest to Deeva (~15 minutes away), took on primary caregiver-daughter role after Harold's death in 2019, and shares Deeva's temperament for order and routine. She brings Deeva's groceries up when the weather is bad, drives her to medical appointments, and stayed two weeks with her immediately after the funeral.

interests: Big Ten football with her husband Tom
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Writes in full sentences, proper capitalization and punctuation, rarely uses emoji beyond a heart or a smile. Sends photos of her garden or of her husband Tom cooking. Texts are often practical logistics ('I'll be up at noon, bringing salad') mixed with affectionate check-ins ('Did you take your BP this morning?').

shared_activities: Sunday lunch at Deeva's house every week (noon, pot roast or chicken pot pie, crossword together afterward)
Driving Deeva to medical appointments
Annual decisions about house maintenance (plow service Rob, furnace repair, lawn care)
Holiday planning (Thanksgiving at Deeva's, Christmas rotating)
Joint coordination of Maggie's care with Maggie's daughter
social_circle.communication_frequency: daily (text) + weekly (in-person Sunday lunch) + ad hoc phone calls
recent_text_topics: Coordinating the mammogram appointment scheduled for May 2026 (Kathy has offered to drive).
Kathy's continued push for Deeva to consider downsizing, usually a single gentle text per month that Deeva ignores or replies 'not yet.'
Check-ins during the February 2025 low stretch, which led Kathy to come up and help clean Harold's workshop — recurring references when either one is having a hard day.
Updates on granddaughter Emma at Grand Valley (nursing program, upcoming summer stay in the guest room).
Logistics around the senior center's first-Thursday Zoom grant committee meeting (Kathy helped Deeva confirm audio settings).
Sharing pictures of Winston being an idiot — the tomato-on-the-counter story Kathy told Deeva on Sunday became a running text thread.

Q31: 'Kathy got me a CGM through Medicare last year.' Q42: 'My daughter Kathy who reads a lot of this stuff.' Q44: 'Kathy noticed and came up and stayed two nights and we cleaned out his workshop.' Q43 follow-up: 'Kathy told me Winston pushed a tomato off the counter and sat on it.'

social_circle.name: Marjorie Klein

demographics.location: Saline, MI (about six blocks from Deeva)
demographics.education: B.A. Library Science, Wayne State University

background.how_they_met: Met in 1972 when their sons were in the same Saline Boy Scout troop; bonded over coordinating pinewood-derby snacks and have been friends ever since
background.why_close: The shared fifty-plus-year arc of Saline motherhood, widowhood (Marjorie's husband Ken passed in 2017), and political/civic alignment — both lifelong Methodists and both moderate-to-Democratic voters — make Marjorie the 'three-in-the-morning' friend. Deeva explicitly names her as the one she would call at 3 a.m.

key_traits: a little bit more adventurous than Deeva
interests: bridge (Tuesday afternoons at the senior center)
donating to and following the Washtenaw County NAACP
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete, slightly formal sentences with the occasional dry joke. Uses ellipses a lot. Not an emoji person — maximum a single exclamation point. Sometimes sends a screenshot of a PBS NewsHour clip or an Ann Arbor News article.

shared_activities: Tuesday 1 p.m. bridge at the Saline Senior Center (with Pat O'Donnell and Ruth Chen)
United Methodist Women meetings (Marjorie is a member; Deeva is treasurer)
Occasional lunch at Mac's Acadian Seafood Shack downtown
Phone and text conversations on news, politics, and family updates
Both attend the 9:30 a.m. service at Saline First United Methodist
social_circle.communication_frequency: 3-4x/week texting + Tuesday in-person bridge + Sunday in-person at church
recent_text_topics: Coordinating who brings snacks to bridge and whether Pat is going to bring up the election again ('Let's just play cards').
The George Floyd anniversary news cycle — Marjorie forwards articles and they discuss them carefully and privately.
Concern about Deeva's sister Maggie's Alzheimer's progression — Marjorie has had an aunt through it and shares gentle practical advice.
Deciding whether to go together to the Saline Summerfest parade in August.
Texts about church fellowship group attendance and whether Pastor Jim's wife Sarah is bringing the scones again.
Commiserating about knees and the walking pace changes (Marjorie also has knee osteoarthritis).
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07: 'My bridge group — four of us. Marjorie Klein, Pat O'Donnell, and Ruth Chen.' and 'Marjorie. We've known each other since 1972 when our kids were in Boy Scouts together. She's the one I'd call at three in the morning.' Q24: 'Marjorie is a lifelong Democrat and we talk.' Q29: 'I have talked about it with my children and grandchildren, and with Marjorie and Eleanor.' Q30: 'Marjorie is engaged.' Q50: 'I cope by... calling Marjorie.'

social_circle.name: Eleanor Brzezinski

demographics.occupation: hospital administrator at Michigan Medicine (still working, plans to retire at 65)
demographics.location: Saline, MI (across the street from Deeva)
demographics.education: B.A. Health Administration, University of Michigan; M.H.A. from U-M

background.how_they_met: Eleanor and her husband moved in across the street in 2014. Deeva brought over a jar of her homemade apple butter as a welcome gift. They began walking together that fall.
background.why_close: Eleanor is Deeva's daily-living lifeline — closer in proximity than any child and reciprocally helpful. Deeva watches Eleanor's dog (a chocolate lab named Cooper) 4–5 times per year when Eleanor travels, and Eleanor checks on Deeva when the power goes out or snow is heavy. They share a pragmatic, secular-but-respectful bond across a 25-year age gap.

interests: hospital-administration work (she complains about it affectionately)
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, efficient texts — she's busy. Uses 'ty' and 'np' and occasional thumbs-up emoji. Will send a photo of Cooper being stupid. Sometimes voice-notes when she's driving.

shared_activities: Monday and Thursday 8 a.m. walking club behind the Saline District Library (2 miles now, down from 3)
Dog-sitting Cooper when Eleanor and her husband travel
Mutual mail-collection and key-checking during trips
Coffee on Eleanor's porch in good weather after walks
Discussion of news, local politics, and race issues on walks
recent_text_topics: Confirming Monday 8 a.m. walk — who brings the water bottle, weather check.
Eleanor asking Deeva if she'd watch Cooper the week of May 18 (she and Dave are going to Traverse City).
Eleanor flagging that the city is repaving a stretch of the walking route in April.
A running thread about the news — especially anything on policing or race, which both women discuss thoughtfully.
Eleanor mentioning her own mother's recent fall and asking Deeva for caregiving perspective.
A joke thread about Winston vs. Cooper — each sends the other their pet's latest crime.

I brought over a jar of my apple butter.' Q15: 'Monday and Thursday are walking club at 8 a.m. behind the library with Eleanor.' Q17: 'I do Ellen's mail and dog when she travels, maybe four, five times a year.' Q18: 'my walking pace has slowed, Eleanor and I used to do three miles and now we do two.' Q29: 'I have talked about it with... Marjorie and Eleanor.' Q30: 'Eleanor and I talk about it fairly often on walks.' Q50: 'walking with Eleanor.'

social_circle.name: Daniel Cintron

demographics.occupation: senior environmental engineer specializing in municipal water systems
demographics.education: B.S. Civil Engineering, Michigan State University; M.S. Environmental Engineering, Oregon State University

background.how_they_met: Deeva's second child, born 1964 in Saline; grew up in the family home, came out at age 22 in 1986
background.why_close: Despite the 2,300-mile distance, Daniel and Deeva share a weekly Sunday 7 p.m. (her time) video call and a steady texting rhythm in between. Their bond was strengthened by the way Deeva and Harold supported Daniel after he came out in 1986 and again when he married Marco in 2015. Deeva is proud of having marched in Detroit Pride with Daniel and Harold in 1990.

key_traits: steady (manages his depression openly with an SSRI)
interests: Pacific Northwest gardening (fig trees, blueberries, dahlias)
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Sends long, thoughtful texts and garden photos with detailed captions. Uses emoji sparingly but with warmth (a single heart, a plant emoji). Voice memos occasionally when on a walk. Will sometimes FaceTime on impulse.

shared_activities: Sunday 7 p.m. Deeva-time video call (4 p.m. Daniel-time), Marco usually pops in to say hello; Daniel walks Deeva around his Portland garden by camera
Texting garden photos back and forth (Deeva's tomatoes in Saline, Daniel's figs in Portland)
Coordinating visits (Daniel flies to Michigan at least once a year, usually July)
Exchanging articles on BLM, gay rights, and water policy
Recipe sharing (Daniel sends Marco's kale frittata recipe; Deeva sends pot pie)
recent_text_topics: Daniel walking Deeva through his early-spring Portland garden via photos — the figs are leafing out, his dahlias are being divided.
A sustained back-and-forth about the political news and what Deeva is reading in the Ann Arbor News.
Planning Daniel and Marco's summer trip to Saline (probably mid-July, staying 5 nights).
Daniel checking in after the February anniversary window to see how Deeva is doing.
A long thread about whether Deeva should let Kathy hire a housekeeper (Daniel is strongly pro, Deeva is resistant).
Sharing a New York Times article about a fellow Park-et-al-style study and debating whether the methodology is sound.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: 'Daniel, our middle, he's sixty-one, he's out in Portland, Oregon... Daniel does something with environmental engineering, water systems. He and his husband Marco have been together twenty-two years, married in 2015.' Q05: 'Daniel I mostly see on video calls, once a week, Sunday evenings.' Q05 follow-up: 'Seven o'clock my time, four his. Marco usually pops in to say hello. Daniel walks me around his garden — they have quite a garden out there in Portland.' Q24: 'Daniel and Kathy are on my side of things.' Q30: 'Daniel and Marco are deep in it, they march, they donate, they talk.' Q39: 'Daniel takes one [antidepressant].' Q46: 'Daniel has been open about his depression since college and takes an SSRI.'

social_circle.name: Rebecca Cintron-Hoffman

demographics.education: A.A.S. Dental Hygiene, Owens Community College

background.how_they_met: Deeva's third and youngest child, born 1968 in Saline
background.why_close: Rebecca comes up from Toledo the first Saturday of every month — a 65-minute drive — and brings one or two of the grandkids when she can. She and Deeva navigate a political gap (Rebecca's husband Greg is a 3x Trump voter; Rebecca is quieter about her own views) with the 2016 family agreement not to discuss politics at the table. Their relationship is affectionate but more reserved than Deeva's with Kathy.

key_traits: a caring but tired mother of three
interests: her three kids (Sophie med school, Caleb Bowling Green, Lily HS)
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Moderate-length texts, uses a smiley emoji and sometimes a heart. Will send photos of the kids and occasional Food Network recipes. Less frequent than Kathy but consistent.

shared_activities: First-Saturday-of-the-month visit to Deeva's house in Saline (about 65 minutes from Toledo)
Phone calls every week or two (distinct from texts)
Coordinating grandchildren milestones (Sophie's engagement, Caleb's college, Lily's school events)
Postpartum-era shared history — Deeva helped Rebecca through postpartum depression after Lily in 2009
Holiday cooking coordination (Rebecca brings a side dish up for Thanksgiving)
recent_text_topics: Planning the first-Saturday April visit (April 4 has already happened; the May 2 visit is on the calendar).
Sophie's wedding planning — she's engaged and Deeva wants to know if there's a date.
Lily's high school sophomore-year sports schedule and whether Deeva should send a card for a track meet.
A careful, polite exchange about Rebecca's Facebook posts (Deeva hid a cousin of Harold's who gets political, and Rebecca noticed).
Photos of Rebecca's garden in Toledo — she's trying tomatoes for the first time and asking Deeva for advice.
Practical updates about Rebecca's 2021 back surgery recovery and ergonomic setup at the dental practice.
